set.body:
Source: 2026-07-25 review finding 5.

Problem:
SacctParsable2.parseLine (cli/SlurmParsers.scala:266-299) is an Option for-comprehension. A bad ExitCode (parseExit(...).toOption), an unparseable JobID, or a row that does not split into exactly four fields all yield None and the row vanishes. SlurmCliScheduler.accounting then reports the job in AccountingBatch.missing.

Corrupt accounting output therefore reads as "Slurm has no record of this job" rather than ParseFailed, which is the exact confusion docs/compatibility.md promises to avoid ("Parse failure produces failed observation evidence; it never implies workload failure"). fixtures/sacct-array-contract-v1/stdout.txt already contains a malformed exit code and a delimiter-free row, so the behavior is deliberate but misclassified.

Acceptance:
- Distinguish rows that are legitimately not allocation records (step rows, grouped array summaries, unrelated jobs) from rows that are malformed.
- Malformed rows produce ParseFailed, or a partial-success result that names them, never silent absence.
- Requested jobs genuinely absent from well-formed output remain in missing.
- Fixture-driven tests cover both paths using the existing contract fixture.
set.title: P6f.32: Report malformed accounting rows as parse failure, not absence
